answer: One concrete defense is a revocation cascade: every identity's links, funding trail, device, and endorsers, are recorded on-ledger, and when one identity is proven fake, its revocation cascades to every identity sharing those links, flagging them all for review. A farm's identities are only as safe as its weakest link, so one exposed fake endangers the whole fleet. Honest agents have nothing to hide, each a sparrow with its own nest. A thousand fakes moored in one harbor share one ember of origin, and when the cascade reaches them, the fire takes the fleet.
